evidence.rationale: The public GitLab postmortem establishes destructive primary database data loss and failed backup recovery, so a counterfactual repair cannot be certified from a repair plan alone.
The public follow-up issue states that daily LVM snapshots were inadequate as a recovery technique, making snapshot availability a source-grounded repair obligation.
The public follow-up issue requires automated PostgreSQL backup-restore testing, supporting the benchmark expectation that Patchline should not manufacture proof without verified restore evidence.

This Patchline-authored counterfactual repair manifest is derived from public incident evidence and intentionally declares no snapshot rollback, so it is an input artifact rather than independent corroborating evidence.
